_comment: Fast Lane plan Sec.7 (2026-08-01): the staleness ledger that makes tiering safe instead of a way
to quietly skip checks. Granularity is the ENTRY POINT a human or agent actually invokes, not
every nested check-*.py -- run-ai-knowledge-gate.ps1 already enforces (via
run-script-inventory-check.ps1's orphaned-gate-checker rule) that no check-*.py is invoked by
nothing; this ledger tracks WHEN each entry point last ran, and every check nested inside an
entry point is covered transitively by that entry point's own run record.
Every entry point run-all-gates.ps1 knows about, plus every check named explicitly in Sec.4/Sec.6
of the Fast Lane plan (T0's model-editing checks, T1's canary checks, T3's release evidence),
MUST appear here -- enforced by check-cadence-coverage.py (wired into run-ai-knowledge-gate.ps1).
maxStaleness values: 'every-run' (T0 -- re-evaluated on every invocation, staleness is meaningless),
'1-wave', '1-move', '7-days' (also read as any release/tag/publish action, whichever is sooner).
Rule (Sec.7.3.5): deadlines are only ever shortened, never extended, to make something pass.

checks.description: The 4 model.schema.json copies stay semantically identical. Cheap enough to run on every edit.

Move 15 Phase D item D1: docs/SCREEN_TAXONOMY.md and the MOVE*_CHECKLISTS/FINDINGS docs don't cite a REG id as a live blocker once that id's own ledger row is DONE/PARTIAL. Cheap doc+ledger scan, no live app needed -- this is the control that was previously entirely missing (verification-cadence.json had 0 entries mentioning the screen record before this).
npdev validate model against the specific model.json being edited. Context-dependent -- only runs (and only counts as overdue) when a -ModelPath was ever given; never-run is not blocking on its own.
gradlew :NPDevContract:dsl:test --tests <touched area>. Context-dependent -- only runs (and only counts as overdue) when a -DslTestFilter was ever given; never-run is not blocking on its own.
Generate + build + boot npdev-canary (the ONE frozen T1 fixture, Sec.5) and run its REST smoke plan (health, one flow, one panel).
Every DSL feature detector has at least one corpus model exercising it.
A field/panel rename does not silently break a hand-written screen, discovered against whatever is currently built under the Build root.
dsl-conformance-max still emits cleanly (NPDevSamples/scripts/generate-sample-app.ps1 -SampleId dsl-conformance-max -NoAssembleFinalApp -- emission only, no build/boot).
run-ai-knowledge-gate.ps1 -- static instrument checks + all in-repo check-*.py, including the script-inventory rule that fails if any checker is hosted by no gate.
run-generator-gate.ps1 -- the codegen engine, including the full 30-model corpus.
run-runtimehost-gate.ps1 -- an assembled sample app + its test suite, including WmsOffice-class interaction surfaces.

checks.description: Move 14 A1: the full-rebuild wall-clock baseline (measured 573s on 2026-08-01) the entire fast-lane tiering plan justifies itself against. A build-time regression is exactly the slow drift this ledger exists to surface -- re-time it periodically rather than letting the one number the plan rests on go stale and unverified.

checks.invokedBy: manual-runbook: S1_SPEC.md O1 -- seed a canary-shaped app (AppGen/apps/s1-scale-canary, or its successor) to 100k CanaryTask rows with the same ~7% selective distribution, re-run the declared query (/api/queries/OpenHighPriorityCanaryTasks), the panel data source (/api/v1/runtime/metadata/ui/panels/CanaryPanel), and the groupBy aggregate (/api/queries/CanaryTaskCountByStatusAndPriority) with JdbcBusinessConceptStore's DEBUG SQL log enabled (-Dlogging.level.com.finalexec.db.JdbcBusinessConceptStore=DEBUG), confirm WHERE/LIMIT/GROUP BY still appear in the captured SQL text (not just a returned row count -- row counts are not proof, see the baseline doc), record in __OutsideRepo/s1/scale-baseline-*.txt, then `python scripts/quality/cadence_state.py record --id scale-baseline --tier T3 --result passed`
checks.description: S1 O1 (2026-08-03): the regression baseline for ConceptQueryPredicateCompiler/JdbcBusinessConceptStore's SQL pushdown at 100k rows -- all three read paths sub-second with real WHERE/LIMIT/GROUP BY in the emitted SQL, none streamed the full table through the JVM. LC-P0 fixed the architecture; nobody had run it at volume before this baseline. A baseline nobody re-measures is the SCREEN_TAXONOMY staleness failure again -- see __OutsideRepo/s1/scale-baseline-2026-08-03.txt for the full numbers.
